banners.title: 高清Sold to the Warlord, Born for the Sky

jump_param.book_title: Sold to the Warlord, Born for the Sky
jump_param.special_desc: Sold into marriage to the dragon-riding warlord of the brutal Blackclaw horde, a sheltered northern princess must decide whether surrendering to the man who bought her is her greatest betrayal or the only thing that can save her dying people.

Wren is labeled wolfless and abandoned by her childhood lover Tristan at his coronation, who publicly rejects their mate bond and lets his lover cut her hair. Heartbroken, she leaves the Dark Moon pack and enters the elite Apex Academy. There, she awakens the rare powerful White Wolf bloodline hidden inside her. With the quiet Frost heir Killian's support, Wren defeats rivals, uncovers Vaelen's evil plot that preys on wolfkin's blood power, and rescues her dad. She stands side by side with Killian to build a new order where no one is forced to kneel for power.

banners.title: 高清Zero to Alpha: Return of the Wolf King

jump_param.book_title: Zero to Alpha: Return of the Wolf King
jump_param.special_desc: Exiled for failing to awaken his wolf form, Nory trained twenty years under three Masters beyond Sacred Rank. Returning to see his mother, he enters the Clan Tournament, shatters the test stone, crushes every foe, and is revealed as the savior three Gold Leaders sought. When vampires invade, he slams the Legendary First Sire through seven walls. Learning his mother was injured saving him, he gathers three sacred relics to heal her. But crimson eyes in distant mist hint a greater threat.

banners.title: 高清The Great and Powerful Genie

jump_param.special_desc: Elijah Baran is a genie in a magic lamp who can grant three wishes. After thousands of years, a billionaire uses his last wish to grant Elijah freedom, but on one condition, Elijah must marry his granddaughter, Christine, for five years! To fulfill the wish, Elijah transforms into a human, marries Christine, and secretly helps her become a successful CEO. However, Christine ignores and constantly belittles him during their marriage. When the five years are almost up, Elijah starts to realize that Christine might never truly love him. He decides to divorce her.

Best friends Ella and Leah married the Harper brothers, firefighter Charles and doctor Noah. On their third anniversary, Charles’s first love locks Ella inside a burning room. When Ella begs Charles for help, he brushes her off to find his ex's cat. Leah rushes in to rescue Ella and calls Noah to save Ella and her baby, but is met with mockery. Heartbroken and betrayed after years of miserable marriages, the best friends decide to file for divorce from the Harper brothers together.

banners.title: 高清My Brothers Begged, But I'm the Dragon's Queen

jump_param.book_title: My Brothers Begged, But I'm the Dragon's Queen
jump_param.special_desc: In the Solis Empire, locked in eternal winter, only a marriage between a princess of pure royal blood and the Abyss Dragon can bring back the warmth of the sun. Princess Diana grew up happy alongside her three brothers — until Lorelei arrived. Using a stolen Dragon's scale, Lorelei seized all of Diana's love and standing. Deceived, the three brothers cast Diana aside — even offering her as a sacrifice to slay the dragon. Only after the dragon took Diana away did the truth emerge. By then, it was too late.

Ten years ago, Elara was adopted by the Alpha of the Stormfang Pack and was destined to choose one of his five sons as her mate. However, the five brothers fall for a manipulative omega maid named Jenny, who schemes to humiliate and torment Elara. Heartbroken and exhausted, Elara publicly rejects her mate bond with the five brothers on her eighteenth birthday and announces her engagement to the mysterious and powerful Lycan Prince, Xavier Lockhart. As the brothers finally uncover Jenny's deception and desperately try to win Elara back, they realize it is too late. Elara finds her true mate in Xavier, breaking his deadly curse, and moves on to a new life, leaving her painful past behind.

banners.title: 高清Rejected Luna Is the Alpha Queen

jump_param.book_title: Rejected Luna Is the Alpha Queen
jump_param.special_desc: After her Moonshadow Pack was slaughtered by rogues, Arya, the werewolf warrior, hides her immense power to honor her mother's dying wish. She marries Alpha Micah, and hides her strength. But then, Alpha Micah breaks his vows and returns from war with a new mate, Vera, and demands that Arya share her Luna title with her. Faced with Vera, Micah, and his family's cruelty, Arya can no longer bear it. She leaves Micah and unleashes the immense power of the White Wolf, reclaiming what is hers with the help of Lowe, the Lycan King. After separating from Micah, Arya discoveres that Vera not only stole Micah from her, but is also the traitor who slaughtered her parents and the Moonshadow Pack. Arya rushes to the battlefield to face her betrayers, and in the process, finds love in Lowe, the Lycan King.

lists.special_desc: After a job interview doesn’t pan out the way Stella Evans plans, she’s desperate to save her house and her mom. When Aston Montgomery gives her the offer of a lifetime — pretend to be his fiancée and mother of his love child in exchange for paying off her debts — she has no choice but to take it. Though it’s all temporary, Stella and Aston soon lose sight of what’s pretend and what’s real. Will Stella always be the borrowed bride, or will she win over the billionaire?
lists.share_text: Will you always be the borrowed bride, or will you win over the single dad billionaire?

lists.special_desc:
Charlotte, adopted daughter of the Harrington family, is drugged and framed by her stepsister Isabella at her engagement banquet. Locked in a tower, she becomes entangled with William, heir of the Ashford family. Pregnant and cast out, Charlotte raises her son Leo alone for eight years.

An alumni dance reunites them. William recognizes Charlotte by his mother's ruby pendant. Desperate for money, Charlotte works at his hotel, and they sign a three-month contract to fake a relationship. Spending time together, William discovers Leo shares his looks and peanut allergy — proof Leo is his son.

Isabella keeps scheming, but her past crimes are exposed. Charlotte is finally recognized as a true Harrington. Leo recovers from surgery, the contract blossoms into real love, and the family of three is happily united.
lists.share_text: The contract was fake. The family was real.

lists.special_desc: Anya Petrova, a brilliant heiress seeking revenge against billionaire Damien Blackwood, infiltrates his inner circle under a false identity. She plans to ruin his reputation and business empire, as Blackwood's actions have led to the downfall of her family. However, as her plans unfold, Anya finds herself unexpectedly drawn to Damien. Despite her initial disdain for him, she is captivated by his charm and intelligence. Their forbidden romance is complicated by their families' bitter rivalry and the secrets of their pasts. Anya must navigate between her desire for justice and her growing feelings for Damien...
lists.share_text: An heiress seeks revenge but falls for the billionaire she’s sworn to destroy.

lists.special_desc: Corrie Scott, a delivery girl who happened to help an old man. To repay her mother's medical debts, she married his grandson, Charles Francis. Charles is the richest man. At the beginning, he thought this girl was a gold digger, so he hid his true identity. As they lived together, their feelings grew deeper. But his lie gradually became a time bomb, and his childhood sweetheart also came back. Will Charles and Corrie get a happy ending?
lists.share_text: Sweet Flash Marriage!

lists.special_desc: Billionaire Blake Thorne returns on Chinese New Year's Eve to surprise his wife, only to find her pregnant. He reveals his true wealth, leaving her family in regret as he cuts all ties.
lists.share_text: Billionaire's new year homecoming, shocking betrayal awaits.

lists.special_desc: 5 years ago, Sienna and Damian had an one night stand. Now, she's back with their daughter Poppy as the CEO of a huge production company in LA. To reconnect with them, Damian hides his billionaire identity and becomes Poppy's manny. Will they stand against the world and build a new life as a family?
lists.share_text: The hot manny you hired turns out to be a CEO!

lists.special_desc: Billionaire magnate Jack retired to spend time with his family. He was once CEO of the world's biggest defense contractor, but he's not just a school janitor. His son throws him out of their house to make space for his new baby. Jack saves a young woman from danger. She's so impressed by his heroics she sets him up with her mother Emma, the icy cold headmistress. They start a contract marriage. The school dean keeps trying to overthrow Emma, Jack swooping in to save her from his schemes, even saving the school from bankruptcy!  Right when Emma is facing unprecedented challenges, about to be removed from the school board, he steps in with billions of dollars to save her from humiliation. His true identity is finally revealed - he's the richest man in the world!

lists.book_title: Fated To My Billionaire Call Boy
lists.special_desc: Diane makes a deathbed promise to her grandmother to have a baby—only to immediately uncover proof of her husband Miles' affair. Devastated, she ends their seven-year marriage. In a drunken rebound move (courtesy of her bold bestie Maggie), Diane spends a wild night with a gorgeous callboy named Eddie… but her night blindness hides a jaw-dropping truth:  Eddie is actually Dominic—her and Miles'college classmate who's been secretly in love with her for years. After studying abroad, he's now returned as a ruthless billionaire… and he'll stop at nothing to win Diane back. By day, he's a powerful tycoon; by night, he voluntarily plays her devoted callboy, determined to make her fall for him.
lists.share_text: Divorce, deceit, and a double life. He’ll be her callboy by night… and destroy her ex-husband by day!

lists.book_title: Don't Toy with My Heart, Mr. Billionaire
lists.special_desc: Adult toy designer Holly is forced to sign a contract marriage with arms dealer Derek after her company’s cash flow collapses. What begins as a simple exchange of interests spirals out of control as they move in together and face escalating crises. Derek is cold, dominant, and in total control, yet he begins to waver in the face of Holly’s resilience and kindness. Holly appears soft on the surface, but she grows stronger with every scheme, betrayal, and wound, learning to fight back. Caught between desire and genuine emotion, they move from using each other to saving each other, confirming their feelings through danger and misunderstanding, and ultimately breaking the contract to choose real love.
lists.share_text: Adult toy designer ignites love with arms dealer.

lists.book_title: Fake Married to My Billionaire CEO
lists.special_desc: After Sam's ex cheats on her and steals her money, Calladan Vandalay marries her at first sight. But he doesn't tell her that he's secretly the richest billionaire in the country. What will Sam do when she finds out? And can they keep their true identities a secret from the preying family and friends in Sam's life?
lists.share_text: Keep your friends close and your enemies closer when marrying a secret billionaire!

lists.book_title: Billionaire Twins Fall in Love with Me
lists.special_desc: Eight years before, the twin heirs fell in love with you at the same time. But fate did them badly, that one died and one suffered amnesia. Eight years later, you encountered the one who don't remember you on a blind date, and he quickly fell for you again. This time, will true love find its way?
lists.share_text: If two handsome guys who look super alike kneel and propose to you, what will you do?

lists.special_desc: When an explosion destroys Dr. Jen Connor’s lab, billionaire heir Roman Johnson rescues her and her comatose sister. Jen offers Roman one impossible deal: she'll pose as his sweet, old-fashioned fiancée for one weekend, so his cold, powerful father may restore the foundation funding she desperately needs. But inside the lavish Johnson estate, Jen faces ruthless tests from staff, family and Roman’s venomous ex-fiancée Kim, who begins to suspect the truth. As romantic tension builds between Jen and Roman, so does the risk of discovery. What starts as a lie becomes dangerously close to real love, just as Kim uncovers the secret Jen hoped would stay buried.
lists.share_text: One Weekend. One Lie. Countless Secrets.

lists.book_title: My Kids' Daddy is a Secret Billionaire
lists.special_desc: Twenty-one-year-old Lisbeth got pregnant after a one-night stand. Desperate for affection, Lisbeth decided to keep the twins and raise them. But the unexpected death of the twins was a constant pain in Lisbeth's heart. Because of her boss's difficulties, Lisbeth decided to quickly find a man to marry. But then she realized that the man she was married to was actually rich? And the Twins did not die.
lists.share_text: One-Night Pregnancy, Double Miracle: Lisbeth's Rich Reunion!

lists.special_desc: To Jason, Tessa was only a disposable practice run for the girl he actually wanted. After the blood on the sheets became a public trophy and her dignity a ghost, young Tessa finally stops trying to mend the shards. She is done with her first love. She is leaving him behind for a future that doesn't taste like salt and shame. But at the edge of the wreckage stands the one person who shouldn’t be there: another boy with no intention of letting her go alone.
lists.share_text: The day she left was the day he lost the world.

lists.special_desc: Switched at birth, Allie had no idea who she really was until she fell for Xander Maddox. That's when she gets her DNA results. Now, she's torn between telling Xander who her father really is and risk losing him or keeping a lie from the man she loves.
lists.share_text: Pick 1 - A billionaire life or an intense love.

lists.special_desc: When poor student Lincoln Cross is hit by campus queen Audrey Sterling, he suddenly gains powerful X-ray vision. His astonishing talent leaves gang heiress Vera Blackwood, stunning sisters Blair Leighton & Amber Collins, and the elegant Audrey Sterling utterly captivated. After all—who wouldn’t want a walking god of wealth? Adapted from a hit web novel.
lists.share_text: Crash into X-Ray Vision! Heiresses Bow Down!

lists.special_desc: Mia Harper, down on her luck, marries wealthy CEO Carter Prescott as part of a deal. Their fake marriage soon blossoms into real romance, but their love is tested when Carter's ruthless ex, Lily, stops at nothing to win him back. The drama intensifies when Mia discovers she's pregnant with Carter's baby and uncovers the shocking truth that Lily is her long-lost stepsister...
lists.share_text: You’re getting married and you don’t know his last name?! But you have to go through with it...

lists.book_title: Taming the Lion: Billionaire on Bikes
lists.special_desc: Leo Striker loves nothing and no one other than his family and his fast rides. That is until Kara Bellini, helpless but resilient, stumbles into his arms. She thinks she escaped from a thug just to fall for another...but Leo turns out to be a BILLIONAIRE?! What else is he hiding beneath his tattoos and leather jacket?
lists.share_text: Will you ride or die with the billionaire on bikes?

lists.book_title: The Break-up Bet With My Billionaire Ex
lists.special_desc: When Layla and Joshua break up, they sign a separation agreement: If they're both still single in five years, they get married. Five years later, after becoming the world's hottest and wealthiest chef, Joshua takes the position of head chef at the restuarant where Layla works. Joshua wants her to fulfill the contract, but with her health in an unstable condition, Layla lies and says she's already engaged. Still, an undeniable chemistry builds between them, and the flames of love become hard to suppress. Will Joshua ultimately discover Layla's lie? Can they bridge the gap of lost time and truly be together again, love conquering all?
lists.share_text: I signed a breakup contract with my billionaire ex.

lists.special_desc: After an unplanned night at a charity gala, the brilliant but down-on-his-luck financial engineer known as Sammy "Sam" Davis gets swept into a whirlwind romance with cold, calculating billionaire Gertrude Lawson. Sam attends the function to sell himself, but everything changes when a case of mistaken identity propels him into the life of Gertrude. With a need for a husband-or else her father will make her forfeit her CEO title-Gertrude sees an opportunity in Sam.In an effort to save his failing business, Sam agrees to a contract marriage with Gertrude, unaware that dangerous family secrets encircle the Lawson empire. As they navigate their fake marriage, emotions become real, but Gertrude’s vengeful ex-fiance, Victor King, and her ruthless sister, Molly, will stop at nothing to tear them apart. The stakes rise as Sam uncovers a mystery that ties his family to Gertrude’s dark past. With betrayal, hidden love, and a looming corporate takeover, Sam and Gertrude must figure out whether their relationship is just a business deal or something more – before it’s too late.
lists.share_text: He married a billionaire for money—and uncovered her dark past.

lists.special_desc: Alexander Whitmore is a struggling street vendor—until he saves Freya Sinclair, the queenpin of Black Sparrow. One impulsive kiss later, they're flash-married. But when Caleb Carter threatens their newfound happiness, Alexander's "poor" parents drop a bombshell: they're the secret founders of Whitmore Capital, a global empire. Now, with his underworld wife by his side and a billion-dollar dynasty behind him, this accidental heir must rise to claim his destiny and protect the woman he loves.
lists.share_text: He saved the Queenpin, married her, and then found he was the heir of the richest family.

lists.book_title: Debt of Desire and Love with a Billionaire
lists.special_desc:
Caitlin pretended to cheat on her boyfriend Francis and broke up with him in order to raise money for her mother's medical treatment. After inheriting a massive fortune, Francis ran into Caitlin again — but due to misunderstandings, he constantly humiliated her. Caitlin hid the truth about her pregnancy. Facing a forced family marriage, a career crisis, and her mother's interference, the two went through countless hardships yet still couldn't let go of each other.
In the end, Francis gave up everything to overcome all obstacles for love. At the critical moment, he saved Caitlin — though he was severely injured and fell into a coma. Caitlin stayed by his side the entire time. After enduring all their trials, the two reunited and welcomed a happy future together.
lists.share_text: She let him hate her. He let her go. Neither could let go.

lists.special_desc:
Cora comes from an ordinary middle-class family. On a rainy night, she is first abandoned by her fiancé Finn, and then entrusted by her ailing father to Neo as someone under his guardianship. Neo is a cold, sharp minded lawyer and the man in power behind the Garcia family, the richest family of all. Forced to live under the same roof with him, Cora finds herself constantly confronting his presence.
Neo is rational and dangerous, a man who never lets anyone get close to him easily—yet Cora seems to be the exception. Through repeated clashes, Cora chips away at Neo's indifference with her intelligence and subtle allure. Meanwhile, Neo struggles between restraint and desire: he wants to push her away, yet cannot ignore the growing pull he feels toward her. Gradually, Cora realizes that what she wants is not merely revenge on Finn, but to take control of her own fate—and to shake the heart of this untouchable man.
But just as Neo finally begins to lower his guard, Cora discovers that deep in his heart there exists someone else: a “white moonlight” who has long since gone to Europe.
lists.share_text: Betrayed Cora meets Neo: melt his heart or be trapped by his secret?

lists.special_desc: Valerie is rejected by her family for being born with a birthmark on her face but Andrew Hills, a hot billionaire, falls in love with her when the two share a moment of passion at a hot spring. He goes on the hunt to find her but in a twist of events, he accidentally hits her with his car and causes her to lose her memory before he discovers who she is. He takes in Valerie while not knowing she's the one he's looking for.
lists.share_text: I can't remember the love of my life!

lists.special_desc: Conscientious class president Emma is keeping a big secret: She's the poorest girl at her wealthy private school. When her rival, uber rich bad boy Lucas Bennett gets her fired from the part time job that's paying her father's medical bills, he makes it up to her — by hiring her to be his personal maid! Lucas agrees to keep their arrangement a secret... as long as Emma caters to his every need.
lists.share_text: You became a maid for your school rival!

lists.special_desc: She came to town for a fresh start. Instead, Penelope Harris got pregnant by her ex’s powerful older brother, Knox Grant– the rugged cowboy who owns the ranch where she works. Now Penelope is caught between the man who would burn the world down for her and her ex, who wants to see her burn.
lists.share_text: One night. Two Brothers. One Baby.

lists.book_title: Heiress Crash Lands on Her Husband
lists.special_desc: In a marathon of trumping identities, Lily must own her cheating ex, his mistress, their moms, her new royal suitor, the women after her true love, and finally, the dominant mother-in-law! Can Lily win them all?
lists.share_text: My identity trumps your identity!

lists.book_title: Open Your Eyes, My Billionaire Husband
lists.special_desc: Hailey is cash-strapped and desperate for a way to pay her mother's heafty medical bills. Her family agrees to help her, on the condition she marries the billionaire Samuel Trent, whom is in a coma after a near-fatal car accident. However, it wouldn't be long before the infamous Samuel Trent would wake up from his coma and discover he's engaged to a complete stranger.
lists.share_text: She was ready to lose it all...but he gave her everything she ever needed.

lists.book_title: The Gourmet CEO Turns out to Be My Baby's Dad
lists.special_desc: Betrayed by her family, Skylar is forced into a compromising situation with a sleazy-looking director in exchange for her grandmother's medical bills. However, she unexpectedly has a one-night stand with Maxwell, CEO of Klein Group, instead, leading to an unplanned pregnancy. Sent abroad, Skyhlar returns six years later with her son and opens a restaurant. Fate eventually brings her and Maxwell back... Will he recognize Skylar as the unforgettable woman from that fateful night?
lists.share_text: When fate brings you and him back...will you tell him the truth?

lists.special_desc: Jaxis a billionaire who falls in love with Daniella, a local girl and sole owner of a bakery named Love and Treats. The couple’s love bubble bursts when Jax’s parents insist he quit car racing and travel to Denmark to take charge of the family business there. They threaten to cut him out of the family inheritance if he doesn’t obey their wish. Jax tells Daniella he’ll be leaving town for Denmark. He asks that she come with him, but she insists she can’t give up her home, friends, and the bakery when marriage is not even in the picture. She accuses Jax of being selfish. Jax accuses her of choosing to be a lowly baker rather than be with him. They break up painfully. Jax tries all he can to keep in touch with Daniella but she ignores his calls and texts. 5 years later, after getting news of his father’s death, Jax returns home to take his father’s position as head of the company. He goes on a mission to woo Daniella back into his life. After several tries, she finally agrees to go out with him. They become a couple again, but Daniella keeps him at arm's length. Everything comes crashing down when Daniella learns that Jax’s company is putting up her building for sale; she gets random calls from strangers asking to buy her bakery. Jax claims he only recently found out about her ownership of the bakery. The couple goes through a rough patch, and painful words are said. Daniella tells him that they’re not compatible. They breakup. Jax packs up and leaves town for Denmark permanently; he can’t stand being in the same town with Daniella and not having her in his life. Daniella discovers she’s pregnant.
lists.share_text: A billionaire’s return reignites a painful past love—until he forces the closure of her bakery, unaware she’s carrying his child.

lists.book_title: Stand Aside, the Billionaire Is Here
lists.special_desc: After six years abroad, Zacarías Montiel builds the world's largest financial empire—the Centurion Group—under the alias "Mr. Z," even helping the current president rise to power. When he quietly returns home to propose to his girlfriend, Isabela, she leaves him to pursue wealth, claiming that only the mysterious Mr. Z is good enough for her. Meanwhile, a small favor leads Zacarías into a sudden marriage with Fernanda Salazar, the beautiful CEO of Prisma Media. At Isabela's housewarming party, she repeatedly tries to kick Zacarías out—unaware of his true identity—until he finally decides to reclaim everything he once gave her.
lists.share_text: The cold CEO is here with a cute daughter, asking me to marry her!

lists.book_title: Bye EX, I'm Having Billionaire's Baby!
lists.special_desc: On her engagement day, Claire catches fiancé David with a prostitute. Betrayed and homeless, she drowns her sorrows at a bar—ending up in CEO Lucas Fletcher's bed. When Lucas becomes her hotel's new owner, their fling turns complicated: she's pregnant, he's protective. Then, a bombshell—Claire is actually a wealthy family's long-lost heir, promised to Lucas in an arranged marriage. Fate seals their love, crowned with twins and a fairy-tale ending.
lists.share_text: From betrayal to bar fling, twins crown Claire's love!

lists.special_desc: Desperate to save her dying mother, Cindy Parks strikes a deal with her boss’s daughter, Nikki Jenkins: Pretend to be Nikki and give her virginity to billionaire Charles Kane. Nikki uses the scheme to trick Charles into marrying her but when she gets sick, Cindy is once again forced to play dress up and step in as a replacement bride.
lists.share_text: You’re forced to dress up as someone else and trade your virginity to a billionaire!

lists.book_title: Selling My Virginity to the Mafia King
lists.special_desc: Desperate to save her dying sister, Tessa agrees to auction off her virginity -- only to be claimed by the most dangerous man in the Mafia. Will she ever be able to trust the man who bought her love... or will trusting him cost her everything?
lists.share_text: Sold to the mafia. Claimed by a king.

lists.book_title: The Billionaire and the Baby Trap
lists.special_desc: To get out of her loveless marriage, Elara needs to get pregnant, but her husband refuses to touch her. One fateful night, she finds herself in Cole's arms, not knowing he's a secret billionaire CEO -- and her husband's uncle. When will Elara realize Cole's identity -- and that he's just the Mr. Right she's been looking for.
lists.share_text: I'm pregnant by my ex's billionaire uncle!

lists.book_title: Spoiling Me, Spoiling You - The Rich Wife's Sweet Game
lists.special_desc: After dying on a night shift, nurse Sophia wakes up as the wife of a top tycoon. But she's immediately accused of being a mistress by the original wife's bitter ex, who even threatens her life. The husband, Spencer, is rich, handsome, and heirless, so Sophia decides to charm him into securing her future. To her surprise, this cold, woman-hating man turns into a loving, doting husband who can't get enough of her.
lists.share_text: She wasn't meant to be his wife, but now she's stealing his heart.
lists.book_sub_title: Made the Cold Billionaire Love Me

lists.book_title: My Homeless Hubby Is a Trillionaire
lists.special_desc: On the eve of her wedding, she discovers her fiancé's infidelity. In a fit of anger, she marries a stranger on a whim. Little did she know that her handsome homeless husband is actually a trillionaire CEO!
lists.share_text: You married a guy you found on the street, but he turned out to be the right one!
lists.book_sub_title: Beneath the Rags: My Hubby Is a Billionaire

lists.book_title: Captured and Bound By My CEO
lists.special_desc: When Lydia West is kidnapped by her rival and forced to marry him for a year to save her dad, she’s sure she’ll hate him forever. But as the truth behind his actions emerges, Lydia is forced to question everything and everyone she thought she knew. Caught between loyalty to her family and her growing feelings for a man she’s supposed to hate, Lydia must decide whether she can resist falling for her captor or let duty tear them apart.
lists.share_text: A lot can change in 365 days.

lists.book_title: Swept Away by My Janitor Husband
lists.special_desc: Ethan, the CEO of Rutherford Enterprises, is undercover as a janitor to uncover a company mole. However, his secret identity complicates things when he falls for Melanie, a secretary at his company. Meanwhile, Melanie, unaware of his true identity, is dealing with betrayal from her fiancé and best friend, as well as family pressure to prove her engagement with a successful man.
lists.share_text:
-The hot janitor... is a billionaire?!
-Surprise! He's not a janitor but a billionaire CEO.
-Mopping floors by day... making billions by night.

lists.book_title: I Don't Know My Husband is a Billionaire
lists.special_desc: Jamie and Renata first met in Morocco five years ago when they got drunk and accidentally married. But when they sobered up the next day, they forgot each other's faces and never saw each other again. Renata is currently single in the United States, but in order to get a work promotion, she needs to find a man to marry in order to gain the trust of her boss. She meets Jamie by accident, mistaking him for an illegal alien who needs to get married to stay in the United States. Renata and Jamie proposed a fake marriage and paid him... What she doesn't know is that Jamie is a talented lawyer and a billionaire. Jamie thought it was funny and agreed to Renata's request. Later, Jamie and Renata face and deal together with Renata's drug-addicted mother and gambling-debt father...
lists.share_text: Forgotten Wed, Fake Team. Jamie & Renata Fight Family!

lists.special_desc: She thought he was just a charming sugar baby - until he bought her company, crashed her marriage, and dropped to one knee. Now, with her life flipped upside down, she has to choose between pride, power… and the billionaire who never stopped loving her.
lists.share_text: A sugar baby turned billionaire. She must choose: pride, power, or the man who never stopped loving her.

lists.book_title: In Love with a Single Farmer-Daddy
lists.special_desc: Natalie's conniving grandmother and sister marry her off to a rural farmer, Rhett. He's a single father, looking after a mute daughter, Ellie. Natalie's presence isn't taken kindly, as she is shunned by Ellie and the woman next door. Over time, she learns the woman next door is actually abusing Ellie. She develops a bond with Ellie, which deepens when Ellie speaks up for the first time to save her. But as Natalie starts settling in, new troubles arise. Ellie is bullied at school, and Natalie gets tangled in conflicts involving both her old and new families. She vows to protect the hard-won love and family she's built.
lists.share_text: Natalie marries a farmer with a silent daughter.

lists.book_title: Love Found Her After the Divorce
lists.special_desc: After a chance encounter reveals her "struggling" husband, Paxon, is actually a billionaire, Sienna's world shatters. When a casual apology is his only offer for gifting jewels to another, she walks away. Now divorced, Paxon expects her to return. But Sienna stuns everyone by entering a marriage contract with a mysterious tycoon.
lists.share_text: True love precedes a remarriage.

lists.special_desc: Everything is for sale, but will you pay the ultimate price?
lists.share_text: Everything is for sale, but will you pay the ultimate price?

lists.book_title: Swapped My Ex for His Billionaire Uncle
lists.special_desc: There was a time when Nina believed her happiest moment would be walking down the aisle with Evan, her college sweetheart. But betrayal shattered that dream, teaching her that true love and forever were rare illusions. After their divorce, she vowed never to give her heart away again. Then Damon—Evan’s youngest uncle—stormed into her life, refusing to let her run. She tries to keep her distance, not wanting ties with her ex’s family, but Damon’s relentless pursuit leaves her breathless.
lists.share_text: Her ex’s uncle won’t stop until she’s his.
